description: Either the preview of a first call (preview) or the result of an executed call (result, warnings); refusals are tool errors, and a CONFLICT error carries a new preview as error.details.preview

warnings.description: E.g. a StartCLI client that differs from the INUBIT version, or a backup manifest that could not be updated

ChangePreview.description: Nothing was changed; with confirmation, call the tool again with the same inputs and confirmation.code before confirmation.expiresAt to execute

target.description: What changes, e.g. the active tag of a user or a tag in one diagram group

before.description: The current state as read, masked: the active tag, or the number of versions carrying the tag in the diagram group and outside it

affected.description: removeTag, deleteTag: the number of workflow and module versions carrying the tag in the diagram group and up to 50 of them

truncated.description: true if ids lists fewer than count

backup.description: What is stored first, or none: <reason>

confirmation.description: Absent under write.confirmation CLIENT, where the first call executes

code.description: One-time code, bound to this {node}, tool and inputs

after.description: The state read again after the change, masked

reReadFailed.description: Instead of after: why the state could not be read again

backup.description: removeTag, deleteTag: the tag list stored before sending (manifest path and id); restore_backup does not restore it
